title: Arkret Agent Selector Claim
description: Signed claim binding a controller-scoped Agent label to one exact Agent AccountId. It permits verified display of a known authorized Agent target, not free-text @<controller-handle>/<agent_slug> resolution. The selector namespace is principal-scoped and the bound target is account-scoped; neither is derived from the other. This claim carries no open claim_scope: zh/identity/identity-handles.md already forbids one on HandleClaimCore, for the reason that an additionalProperties:true object cannot carry state a MUST-level authorization decision depends on and still have every verifier decide alike. visibility and audience are the registered disclosure boundary, and intent is a request parameter rather than a claim member.

controller_subject_id.description: Controller principal DID that owns the selector namespace.

agent_slug.description: Controller-scoped slug used only as a label for an already-known authorized full Agent AccountId.

subject_account_id.description: Exact Agent AccountId for bind; null for an explicitly signed unbind of this controller/slug. Causal head supersession is applied before expiry/validity filtering; superseded bindings never revive.

issuer_id.description: Controller DID signing this claim; MUST equal controller_subject_id. The Event actor is its controller account in that account's principal-control Realm.

vouching_id.description: Optional service-only vouching role that served or vouched for this selector claim when distinct from issuer_id. The service subject-class requirement is validated independently of the field name.

visibility.description: Disclosure boundary for current known-account label verification. Restricted/private claims require audience and requester policy checks before disclosing the claim or label; the claim never authorizes free-text target lookup.

audience.description: Audience binding for restricted selector disclosure, such as a Realm ID, verifier domain, or service DID.

source_refs.description: Optional refs to accountability_grant, actor profile, provisioning, delegation, or revocation evidence.
